rules.title: HTTP Strict Transport Security is not enabled
rules.observation_summary: The final HTTPS response did not include Strict-Transport-Security.
rules.impact: Browsers are not instructed to require HTTPS for later visits to this origin.
rules.remediation: Return Strict-Transport-Security on HTTPS responses after confirming every covered host supports HTTPS.
rules.verification: Run another Review and confirm REF.HTTP.HSTS.PRESENT evaluates PASS.

rules.title: Content Security Policy is not declared
rules.observation_summary: The final response did not include Content-Security-Policy.
rules.impact: The browser has no origin-specific CSP restrictions to limit unexpected resource execution.
rules.remediation: Deploy a tested Content-Security-Policy tailored to the application and monitor violations before tightening it.
rules.verification: Run another Review and confirm REF.HTTP.CSP.PRESENT evaluates PASS.

rules.title: MIME sniffing protection is not declared
rules.observation_summary: The final response did not include X-Content-Type-Options.
rules.impact: Some responses may be interpreted using MIME sniffing instead of the declared content type.
rules.remediation: Return X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff on application responses.
rules.verification: Run another Review and confirm REF.HTTP.NOSNIFF.PRESENT evaluates PASS.

rules.title: Referrer policy is not declared
rules.observation_summary: The final response did not include Referrer-Policy.
rules.impact: The origin relies on browser defaults for cross-origin referrer disclosure.
rules.remediation: Return an explicit Referrer-Policy compatible with the application's navigation requirements.
rules.verification: Run another Review and confirm REF.HTTP.REFERRER_POLICY.PRESENT evaluates PASS.

rules.title: Permissions Policy is not declared
rules.observation_summary: The final response did not include Permissions-Policy.
rules.impact: Browser feature access is not constrained by an origin-specific policy header.
rules.remediation: Return a Permissions-Policy that grants only browser features required by the application.
rules.verification: Run another Review and confirm REF.HTTP.PERMISSIONS_POLICY.PRESENT evaluates PASS.
